about.heading: AI Virtual Receptionist for Massage Therapists

sections.subheading: Simplify and Modernize Your Massage Practice
sections.paragraph: At VirtualAssistant.com.au, we know how busy massage therapists can be between back-to-back appointments. Our AI Virtual Receptionist is designed to take care of your phone calls, bookings, and client inquiries — so you can focus entirely on delivering a relaxing, professional experience.

sections.subheading: More Time for Clients, Less Time on the Phone
sections.paragraph: Our AI Receptionist works like your personal front desk assistant — answering every call, explaining services, handling bookings, and sending appointment reminders. Whether you’re with a client or the clinic is closed, your AI receptionist ensures no message or potential booking slips through.

sections.subheading: Never Miss a Client Opportunity Again
sections.paragraph: Even when you’re busy giving treatments, your AI Receptionist keeps your business moving. It can discuss available services like relaxation, remedial, or deep tissue massage, provide accurate pricing and duration details, and confirm bookings instantly. You’ll never lose a client because of a missed call again.

Let our AI take care of reception — so you can focus on relaxation, recovery, and results for your clients.

All information is organized securely in your dashboard, making it easy to track sessions, manage follow-ups, and deliver a personalized client experience.
